-- Santal - Inde
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Santal de Mysore', 'Qualité premium, très recherchée'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Santal%' AND t.country LIKE '%Inde%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Bergamote - Calabre (Italie)
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Bergamote de Calabre', 'DOP, qualité exceptionnelle pour parfumerie'
FROM plants p, terroirs t
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Bergamote%' AND t.country LIKE '%Italie%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Encens - Oman
INSERT INTO plant_terroirs (plant_id, terroir_id, local_name, quality_notes)
SELECT p.id, t.id, 'Oliban du Dhofar', 'Qualité Hojari, la plus précieuse'

WHERE p.name LIKE '%Encens%' AND t.country LIKE '%Oman%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plant_terroirs pt WHERE pt.plant_id = p.id AND pt.terroir_id = t.id)
LIMIT 1;
